items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Freddie Kepper, did you ever hear him?

ctx.x: Freddie Kepper, did you ever hear him? Yeah, the Kepper's brother, yeah.
There was one playing guitar. Louie Kepper. Louie, yeah, I know him personally, yes. I know him.
